hypothesis: High initial contract volume plus next-session OI carryover and same-direction ask-side follow-through improves expectancy versus volume-only flow.
entry_trigger: initial contract volume from notable whale flow adds contract to watchlist
confirmation_rules: next trading day after 6:35 AM PT: OI >= entry OI + max(100, 25% of entry volume)
same-direction ask-side premium exceeds bid-side premium
contract price holds above intraday average
exit_rules: OI fades after next market open
contract price breaks below intraday average by configured threshold
